queries.sql: WITH priced AS (SELECT a.asset_id, a.sector, dp.trading_date, dp.adjusted_close AS close_end, LAG(dp.adjusted_close, 20) OVER (PARTITION BY a.asset_id ORDER BY dp.trading_date) AS close_lag20 FROM synthetic_market.main.assets a JOIN synthetic_market.main.daily_prices dp ON a.asset_id = dp.asset_id) SELECT sector, COUNT(DISTINCT asset_id) AS issuer_count, median((close_end / close_lag20) - 1) AS median_return FROM priced WHERE trading_date = DATE '2026-08-31' AND close_lag20 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sector ORDER BY sector;
